definitions.explanation: The act of passing another vehicle while driving; moving ahead of someone or something that was in front.

examples.japanese: {追|お}い{越|こ}し⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧です。
⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧な{追|お}い{越|こ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{追|お}い{越|こ}し⟦{車線|しゃせん}→車線：18949_shasen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{右側|みぎがわ}→右側：24189_migigawa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The passing lane is on the right side.

notes:
{追|お}い{越|こ}し is the noun form of the verb ⟦{追|お}い{越|こ}す→追い越す：04623_oikosu⟧ (to overtake, to pass).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {追|お}い{越|こ}し⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧: no passing, overtaking prohibited
- {追|お}い{越|こ}し⟦{車線|しゃせん}→車線：18949_shasen⟧: passing lane
- {追|お}い{越|こ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to overtake
- ⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧な{追|お}い{越|こ}し: dangerous overtaking

TRAFFIC RULES:
- In Japan, vehicles drive on the left, so passing lanes are on the right
- {追|お}い{越|こ}し⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧ signs indicate zones where overtaking is not allowed
